remarks: Stunning Center-Hall Colonial on Expansive Park-Like Acre in Desirable Neighborhood Nestled on a beautifully rolling acre, this home offers the perfect backdrop for your dream lifestyle. The formal living room is highlighted by a cozy wood-burning fireplace with a classic mantel and a bay window, all accessible through new French doors that open to an extended patio-ideal for relaxing or entertaining. The spacious eat-in kitchen features a center island and casual dining with French doors leading to the back patio, perfect for outdoor meals and gatherings. The formal dining room offers a seamless flow with French doors that connect to the eat-in kitchen. Spacious family room plus office includes a wet bar and a private front patio, making it a great retreat or workspace. The first floor also offers a guest room with a walk-in closet and a full bath, providing comfort and privacy for visitors. Upstairs, the master suite is a true sanctuary, featuring a walk-in closet and full bath. Two additional bedrooms share a well-appointed hall bath. A fully finished lower level provides a spacious playroom, office, den and more. This home combines elegance, functionality, and charm in one of the area's most sought-after neighborhoods.
